slo_title: Discuss serialization use cases in distributed and enterprise applications

mcq.q: Why is serialization important for data persistence?

options.A: a) It deletes objects from memory
options.B: b) It transforms objects into executable files
options.C: c) It saves the state of an object to a file or database ​​​​​
options.D: d) It speeds up program execution

mcq.answer_text: c) It saves the state of an object to a file or database ​​​​​

mcq.q: Which Java interface must a class implement to be serializable?
Which is a typical enterprise use case for serialization?

options.C: c) Storing session data in web applications ​​​​​

mcq.answer_text: c) Storing session data in web applications ​​​​​

mcq.q: What is object serialization in programming?

options.B: b) Converting an object into a byte stream for storage or transmission
options.C: c) Encrypting data before sending it ​​​​​
options.D: d) Creating static instances of a class

mcq.answer_text: b) Converting an object into a byte stream for storage or transmission

mcq.q: In distributed systems, serialization is mainly used to______

options.A: a) Print objects to the console
options.B: b) Transmit object data across networks

mcq.answer_text: b) Transmit object data across networks

sq.q: An application using dynamic memory allocation frequently crashes due to heap exhaustion. What could be the underlying cause?
answer: Inefficient memory deallocation or holding references unnecessarily may lead to memory leaks, resulting in uncollected objects and heap overflow.

sq.q: A system's response time suffers due to frequent use of dynamic method calls. How does direct procedure calling improve performance in such cases?
answer: Direct procedure calls are resolved at compile time, eliminating runtime lookup and enabling optimizations like inlining, which reduce execution overhead.
